introHtml: Koozie first aid kits combine the trusted durability of Koozie brand products with practical emergency preparedness. Made from rugged materials like polyester and nylon, these kits withstand outdoor use at job sites, events, or fleet vehicles. Choose from soft-sided pouches or hard cases, and add your logo with screen printing or embroidery. They offer a smart way to promote safety while keeping your brand visible.
